$schema_note: Soul Lane 3 — Hero XP / Levels / Skills / Classes / Companion Roles. Deterministic, save-friendly, additive over the CURRENT frozen snapshot 2c3a9055d71a87ed3ed8b8abf08503efa1218f7c. This document describes the DATA CONTRACT only; see HANDOFF.md for exact source symbols. Labels: VERIFIED = reads from current snapshot, PROPOSAL = additive design not yet in code.

fields.ArtifactSlots: TArray<FName> (declared, currently UNUSED by any rule or save path — see unknowns)

VERIFIED_current_rules.label: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT
VERIFIED_current_rules.add_experience: Adds amount (ignored if <=0); loops while Experience >= ExperienceForLevel(Level+1), each loop: ++Level, ++UnspentSkillPoints; returns bLeveled.
VERIFIED_current_rules.spend_skill_point: SpendSkillPoint(Hero,SkillId,MaxRank=3): requires UnspentSkillPoints>0 and non-None id; Rank=Skills.FindOrAdd(SkillId); fails if Rank>=max(1,MaxRank); else ++Rank,--UnspentSkillPoints.
VERIFIED_current_rules.spend_mana: SpendMana clamps cost>=0; fails if Mana<cost else Mana-=cost.
VERIFIED_current_rules.apply_battle_injury: Wounded with survivors -> Condition=Wounded, RecoveryDays=3 (never restarts an existing wound clock); 0 survivors -> Condition=Captured, RecoveryDays=0, CaptorFaction=Opponent, CaptureRegion=Region. Captured heroes are not re-injured.
VERIFIED_current_rules.advance_recovery: Only Wounded decays; RecoveryDays-- and at 0 -> Healthy. Captured does NOT auto-recover (lives in Lane 4 prisoner lifecycle).

VERIFIED_current_availability_gates.label: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT
VERIFIED_current_availability_gates.note: Wounded and Captured heroes cannot command sieges, perform diplomacy, or (per subsystem) reduce AP via Adventure skill.

VERIFIED_current_skill_ids.label: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT

subsystem_ChooseSkill_recognized.Adventure: ChooseSkill: Economy.MaxActionPoints++ and ActionPoints++. Separately MovePlayerTo: if Skills.Adventure>=2 and hero IsAvailable, strategic move costs 0 AP.

VERIFIED_current_skill_ids.test_only_skill_id: war_magic (used in SoulMechanicsTests.cpp FSoulHeroProgressionTest, default MaxRank=3)
VERIFIED_current_skill_ids.note: ChooseSkill forwards MaxRank=2 explicitly; FSoulHeroRules default is 3. There are currently only TWO gameplay-wired skills (Adventure, Magic). This lane's domain model is a PROPOSAL that MUST remain backward compatible with these two ids.

PROPOSAL_hero_progression_schema_v0.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
PROPOSAL_hero_progression_schema_v0.principle: Add NO new struct. Reuse FSoulHeroState.Skills (TMap<FName,int32>) with namespaced skill ids and FSoulHeroState.Kind-driven archetype binding by data, not by code branching. Keep deterministic, integer-only, save round-trippable through the existing Soul.Campaign JSON domain.

level_cap.rationale: Keeps curve meaningful across a 30-day campaign (Lane 9); L10 cumulative XP 11250 ~= 31 region captures or ~31 battle wins. Avoids giant perk trees per shared rules.

PROPOSAL_hero_progression_schema_v0.skill_point_grant: 1 per level (UNCHANGED from AddExperience). At cap 10 => 9 lifetime points after start (plus any start bonus).

skill_rank_cap_default.note: FSoulHeroRules default already 3. PROPOSAL: domains below use rank cap 3; the subsystem's hard-coded ChooseSkill MaxRank=2 should be widened to the per-skill cap authored in data (see HANDOFF implementation order).

PROPOSAL_hero_progression_schema_v0.skill_id_namespace: domain.skill, lowercase dot-delimited, stable forever (e.g. command.rally, martial.duelist, magic.attunement, logistics.forced_march, diplomacy.envoy, stewardship.builder). 'Adventure' and 'Magic' retained as LEGACY ALIASES mapped to logistics.pathfinder and magic.attunement respectively so existing saves and tests never break.
PROPOSAL_hero_progression_schema_v0.determinism: No RNG in progression. All level-ups, point grants and skill effects are pure functions of (Experience, Skills, Level). Battle RNG stays in RBCombat; progression consumes only post-battle authoritative results.

PROPOSAL_additive_fields.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
PROPOSAL_additive_fields.note: If ANY new field is added to FSoulHeroState it MUST be optional in the save JSON with a safe default, mirroring how hero_kind/result_mana are treated as optional-with-default in RestoreRBSaveDomain (see SoulCampaignManaTests legacy test). Preferred: add ZERO new struct fields in V0 by encoding archetype and assignment role as skill-map/data lookups.

preferred_zero_field_v0.archetype: Derived from data table keyed by HeroId (FSoulHeroArchetypeTable, read-only content). Not stored on the hero; recomputed on load. No save impact.
preferred_zero_field_v0.assignment_role: PROPOSAL field 'FName AssignmentRole' ONLY if Independent Commander / Governor ship. V0 can represent companion-vs-independent purely with existing bCompanionAssigned bool in the subsystem. Governor is V2.

if_assignment_role_added.schema_version_bump: NOT required if treated as optional-with-default per existing legacy-tolerance pattern; a bump to schema v2 is only required if a field becomes mandatory.

ArmyCompanion.effect: Hero travels with and fights inside an army; contributes command/martial/magic in RBCombat as the player/non-player hero.

IndependentCommander.effect: Hero leads its own small army; uses CanCommandSiege gate; can be wounded/captured independently.
IndependentCommander.requires: army-ownership binding that does not yet exist for player heroes (see unknowns).

Governor.effect: Hero assigned to a settlement region; passive stewardship bonus (e.g. +gold/day or -build-days) via settlement authority. Must route through existing Soul.Settlements authority, never a second economy authority.
